package.name: ur5_project
package.description: Final project for the course "Kinematics and Dynamics of Robots" (362-1-4231) at Ben-Gurion University of the Negev. Implements full UR5 simulation: forward and inverse kinematics, workspace analysis, Jacobian, statics, Cartesian trajectory planning with trapezoidal velocity profile, and integration with Gazebo Harmonic via ROS2 Jazzy.
